results.title: The Prompts column of the organisations list is sortable
results.error: Step "Then the organisations without a pool are not mixed between the others": expected "Every "—" row is grouped together, never between two organisations with a value". Observed: default view (Status = active, 8 organisations, 1 page) correct in both directions (asc 246 / 250, 471 / 1000, 713 / 1000 then 5 x "—"; desc 713, 471, 246 then 5 x "—"). With Status = all statuses (26 organisations, 2 pages of 20) the sort is applied to the current page only: desc page 1 = 713 / 1000, 246 / 250, then 18 x "—"; page 2 = 471 / 1000 (Onclusive), then 5 x "—". So 471 comes after 246 and 18 "—" rows sit between organisations with a value. No sort parameter is sent to GET /admin/organisations?page=N&size=20.
